Glasgow fintech Kilo raises $4m from US investors

Kilo, a Glasgow-based fintech startup, has raised $4 million from a group of US investors led by a California fund.

The company, which provides invoice-financing software, says the money will be used to open a New York office and expand its sales team.

Kilo was founded in 2022 and has processed more than £30 million of invoices to date, according to its founders.
